inputs.attribution: nflverse/nflfastR player-game derivatives; prepared by Session B

history: H-RECENT season-relative preceding season + earlier current labels; feature memory expanding from2022
timing: Historical label and context availability=kickoff+7days strict<; weekly fit before earliest game kickoff; query refresh at own kickoff leftlimit.
source_vintage: Current/revised sources under disclosed +7day reconstruction; not authenticated historical publication.
population: Retrospective officialQBstat-row query panel; unknown participation retained. Not an exante roster or originally issued forecast.
targets_remaining: Other10categories remain in parent championship; A owns rushing and C receiving/alignment.

validation.objective: Mean full-game completion gamma-Poisson NLL using predicted attempts and predicted down/depth mix
validation.tie_break: menu order4,8,16 then20,80; no evaluated2025/2026outcomes used for this selection

direct.learner: unchanged32-tree ExtraTrees/Leaf-CDF settings and95/5 empirical-prior law
direct.training_scope: QB-only new controlled direct baseline, not a renamed old broad-position fit
direct.E0: Existing own-target mean3/8,last4/age/missing/position fields; new QB-only training control.
direct.E1: E0+earlier own25-state down/depth proportions, shrunk completion rates/support and historical field context summaries.
direct.E2: E1+16scheduled-defense-game context residuals versus earlier offense-quality reference; support retained.
direct.E3: E2+25explicit own predicted-mix x opponent-context residual products. Forest may already learn implicit interactions; no forced feature use.

personalization.P1: Shared conditional contextGLM with pregame history fields and offense/defense main effects.
personalization.P2: Same inputs + penalized QB intercepts; pooling strength selected in earlier2024validation.
personalization.P3: Player-only conditionalGLM trained only on own last16eligiblegames; shared feature definitions; min8priorgames and160attempts, else exact P1fallback.
personalization.volume: One common empirical gamma-Poisson attempt forecast, not three independent exposure models.
personalization.integration: Exact sum over25predicted contexts; binomial thinning of common gamma-Poisson attempts. No realized target-game mix/exposure supplied.
personalization.uncertainty: Exposure gamma-Poisson uncertainty modeled; completion coefficients/context weights are point estimates. No claim of full posterior uncertainty.
personalization.receiver_effects: Explicit QB-receiver/alignment extension awaits C; no causal attribution of all conversion to QB.

selection.primary: Existing P1 unrounded mean/median direction and exact-law statistical probability direction, kept separate.
selection.conditioning: Physical-participation statistical crossing; no bookmaker nonvoid/EV claim.
selection.timing: Chronological game batches with remaining weekly slots, percategory and side; unqualified quote clocks remain diagnostic, never an original selectable list.

audit_controls: Preserve collapse holds, explicitnull/playedzero/unknown labels and source versions. No intercept/ranker repair, Cfeature-use rerun, Aallocation or Astra study.
existing_strong_control: Reuse retained exact Leaf/R0 outputs on named common rows where cutoff/label/role contracts match; no completed equivalent refit.
legacy_recovery_gate: Unchanged;thisindependentqualifiedpublic-derivedpackage consumes no un-restored legacy model or source.
retention: Before broad run verify this input+code/protocol+pilot typed parameters through GitHub. No public rawfeeds, restricted offers, private paths or unsafe model serialization.
release: No automatic release; five scored product-weeks and owner admission separately required.
